catch-error-name.reason: Error variable spelling does not improve lifecycle correctness; keep context-specific names.

consistent-assert.reason: Tests use Vitest and runtime inputs use schemas; no additional assertion convention is needed.

consistent-date-clone.reason: Date-cloning syntax is a preference and is not a current resource issue.

consistent-empty-array-spread.reason: Conditional immutable construction is intentional in feature models.

consistent-existence-index-check.reason: Existing index comparisons can express their boundary conditions explicitly.

consistent-function-scoping.reason: Feature-local closures deliberately own injected dependencies and state.

consistent-template-literal-escape.reason: Escape spelling adds style churn without changing resource safety.

custom-error-definition.reason: Existing typed app errors intentionally carry status fields and need no new class template.

empty-brace-spaces.reason: Oxfmt owns whitespace; a second formatter policy would duplicate it.

error-message.reason: Require useful error messages for failures surfaced through adapters and logs.

escape-case.reason: Oxfmt and readable regexes suffice; escape capitalization is cosmetic.

explicit-length-check.reason: Boolean collection checks are already clear and need no mechanical rewrite.

explicit-timer-delay.reason: Make scheduling delays explicit when creating asynchronous work.

filename-case.reason: Oxlint exposes this as a compatibility placeholder; it cannot enforce filename policy here.

import-style.reason: Package export boundaries matter more than a uniform named/default import preference.

max-nested-calls.reason: Schema and model composition legitimately nests calls; a depth limit is arbitrary.

new-for-builtins.reason: Catch accidental calls or constructions with the wrong built-in constructor convention.

no-abusive-eslint-disable.reason: The rule targets ESLint directives; this repository uses Oxlint directives.

no-accessor-recursion.reason: Prevent accessors recursively reading or writing themselves until stack exhaustion.

no-anonymous-default-export.reason: Small Vite and Vitest configuration exports do not need artificial names.

no-array-callback-reference.reason: Typed pure helpers are useful callbacks; do not ban all function references.

no-array-fill-with-reference-type.reason: Prevent repeated references sharing mutable board cells or model rows.

no-array-for-each.reason: For-each and loops are both valid; existing cleanup callbacks are readable.

no-array-method-this-argument.reason: No architectural reason to prohibit an explicit callback receiver.

no-array-reduce.reason: Pure reductions are valid domain/model code; blanket bans do not prevent leaks.

no-array-reverse.reason: Mutation of freshly owned arrays can be intentional; ownership needs semantic review.

no-array-sort.reason: Sorting local query/result arrays is intentional; avoid unconditional copying.

no-await-expression-member.reason: Reading a property of an awaited result is safe and compact.

no-await-in-promise-methods.reason: Prevent accidentally serializing operations intended to run concurrently.

no-confusing-array-with.reason: Catch easily mistaken Array.with calls that silently replace an element.

no-console-spaces.reason: Spacing in console strings is cosmetic and unrelated to redaction or retention.

no-document-cookie.reason: Browser tests inspect cookie isolation; production credentials already use HttpOnly cookies.

no-empty-file.reason: Empty fixture files can intentionally represent missing content.

no-hex-escape.reason: Equivalent escape notation does not warrant source churn.

no-immediate-mutation.reason: Building then populating locally owned data is explicit and valid.

no-instanceof-array.reason: Use cross-realm-safe Array.isArray at validation boundaries.

no-instanceof-builtins.reason: Existing Error and browser-object narrowing is intentional; blanket restrictions are unsuitable.

no-invalid-fetch-options.reason: Catch invalid request options before transport behavior fails at runtime.

no-invalid-remove-event-listener.reason: Reject fresh functions or bound functions that cannot remove the registered listener.

no-length-as-slice-end.reason: Redundant slice bounds are readability preferences rather than a resource defect.

no-lonely-if.reason: Guard grouping sometimes documents state relationships better than flattened branches.

no-magic-array-flat-depth.reason: The few explicit flattening depths describe known domain structures.

no-negated-condition.reason: Early returns and discriminated-state branches can read naturally with negation.

no-negation-in-equality-check.reason: Avoid inverted equality expressions whose coercion or precedence is easy to misread.

no-nested-ternary.reason: Compact discriminated-state projections are already checked by types and tests.

no-new-array.reason: Avoid ambiguous Array constructor overloads and accidental sparse arrays.

no-new-buffer.reason: Reject deprecated Buffer constructors with unsafe allocation semantics.

no-null.reason: Null is intentional in SQL, contracts, schemas and discriminated client state.

no-object-as-default-parameter.reason: Explicit options defaults are valid; do not impose one signature style.

no-process-exit.reason: CLI tooling may terminate with a status; application shutdown has its own cleanup path.

no-single-promise-in-promise-methods.reason: Uniform aggregation can preserve adapter structure and timing; no blanket simplification.

no-static-only-class.reason: This is an abstraction preference; existing public API boundaries are already enforced.

no-thenable.reason: Prevent objects from unexpectedly participating in promise assimilation.

no-this-assignment.reason: Receiver capture is not inherently a leak and may be required by a callback API.

no-typeof-undefined.reason: Explicit transport/browser parsing checks are intentionally allowed by project policy.

no-unnecessary-array-flat-depth.reason: An explicit depth may document expected structure; this is a style preference.

no-unnecessary-array-splice-count.reason: Explicit deletion counts can communicate intent in local mutation.

no-unnecessary-await.reason: Await can intentionally introduce ordering even for a currently synchronous value.

no-unnecessary-slice-end.reason: Explicit bounds are harmless and may aid boundary reasoning.

no-unreadable-array-destructuring.reason: Tuple positions sometimes matter; enforce readability through review rather than hole counts.

no-unreadable-iife.reason: No project-wide IIFE form is needed; initialization code can stay local.

no-useless-collection-argument.reason: Redundant empty construction arguments are cosmetic rather than retained-state defects.

no-useless-error-capture-stack-trace.reason: Error stack customization is rare and is better reviewed with the concrete error type.

no-useless-fallback-in-spread.reason: Keep explicit immutable construction and defaults consistent with existing model policy.

no-useless-iterator-to-array.reason: Nursery rule; defer adoption until implementation and diagnostics stabilize.

no-useless-length-check.reason: An explicit empty guard may document a case; no safety gain justifies rewriting it.

no-useless-promise-resolve-reject.reason: Promise normalization can document an adapter contract and preserve timing intent.

no-useless-spread.reason: Explicit copy boundaries can matter for model ownership; avoid broad simplification.

no-useless-switch-case.reason: Explicit grouped cases support exhaustive message handling and future changes.

no-useless-undefined.reason: Explicit undefined values are meaningful in typed optional fields and test fixtures.

no-zero-fractions.reason: Numeric spelling is cosmetic and does not affect precision.

number-literal-case.reason: Literal capitalization is a style preference.

numeric-separators-style.reason: Numeric grouping should follow domain readability rather than one enforced grouping width.

prefer-add-event-listener.reason: Owned EventSource error handlers use property assignment legitimately; cleanup is explicit.

prefer-array-find.reason: Avoid allocating a filtered array when only its first match is needed.

prefer-array-flat.reason: Changing concatenation idioms is not needed for correctness or current resource findings.

prefer-array-flat-map.reason: Existing filter/map and domain transformations are intentionally permitted by project policy.

prefer-array-index-of.reason: Equivalent search forms can preserve clearer domain intent.

prefer-array-some.reason: Existence checks are readable in several forms; broader transformations are not necessary.

prefer-at.reason: Index arithmetic can express board and tuple relationships explicitly.

prefer-bigint-literals.reason: BigInt spelling is a style preference and is not a current domain concern.

prefer-blob-reading-methods.reason: FileReader adapters deliberately model cancellation and stale reads; do not rewrite their lifecycle.

prefer-class-fields.reason: Class layout is a style choice; models use plain data and functions.

prefer-classlist-toggle.reason: Explicit DOM branches can preserve lifecycle intent without changing behavior.

prefer-code-point.reason: Tile code intentionally distinguishes code points from code units where needed; review each case.

prefer-date-now.reason: Avoid allocating Date objects just to obtain the current timestamp.

prefer-default-parameters.reason: Defaulting inside validated adapters may be more explicit than signature defaults.

prefer-dom-node-append.reason: DOM insertion choice is not relevant to the current allocation fixes.

prefer-dom-node-dataset.reason: Attribute access is useful in test and generic DOM adapters.

prefer-dom-node-remove.reason: DOM removal style is not the same as lifecycle cleanup correctness.

prefer-dom-node-text-content.reason: The syntactic rule also flags Playwright Locator.innerText, where rendered visible text is intentional.

prefer-event-target.reason: Do not replace Node event APIs solely to satisfy a stylistic architecture preference.

prefer-export-from.reason: Explicit imported bindings may also be used locally and aid boundary review.

prefer-global-this.reason: Browser APIs remain clearly browser-local; qualifying every access adds churn.

prefer-import-meta-properties.reason: Existing URL/path helpers are explicit and compatible with the pinned toolchain.

prefer-includes.reason: Existing index comparisons may encode more than simple membership.

prefer-keyboard-event-key.reason: Use meaningful keyboard keys instead of obsolete numeric key codes.

prefer-logical-operator-over-ternary.reason: Explicit conditional defaults can be clearer at parsing boundaries.

prefer-math-min-max.reason: Explicit boundary branches can be easier to verify than mechanical min/max rewrites.

prefer-math-trunc.reason: Numeric conversion intent must be reviewed with the input type; no blanket rewrite.

prefer-modern-dom-apis.reason: Generic DOM adapters and tests may need established APIs with explicit behavior.

prefer-modern-math-apis.reason: Rare math expressions are domain-specific and are not a memory-safety concern.

prefer-module.reason: The repository is ESM already; native bundle interop intentionally uses createRequire.

prefer-native-coercion-functions.reason: Explicit parsing and validation must not be reduced to coercion preferences.

prefer-negative-index.reason: Existing indices can communicate position and board bounds explicitly.

prefer-node-protocol.reason: Make built-in Node imports unambiguous from third-party packages.

prefer-number-coercion.reason: Do not mechanically replace deliberate parsing/coercion at runtime boundaries.

prefer-number-properties.reason: Global versus Number predicates can differ in coercion; changes need input-specific review.

prefer-object-from-entries.reason: Explicit dictionary construction can preserve validation and inference more clearly.

prefer-optional-catch-binding.reason: Unused catch binding cleanup is cosmetic and already visible to other diagnostics.

prefer-prototype-methods.reason: Explicit calls can be clearer than prototype rewrites at compatibility boundaries.

prefer-query-selector.reason: DOM lookup choices are context-specific and do not establish listener cleanup.

prefer-reflect-apply.reason: Conflicts with the agreed anti-slop/no-reflect-apply rule.

prefer-regexp-test.reason: Some match calls intentionally retain captures; changing matching idioms is unnecessary.

prefer-response-static-json.reason: Hono owns response construction; raw Responses in tests intentionally exercise body lifecycle.

prefer-set-has.reason: Tiny immutable arrays are appropriate; adding long-lived sets can increase retained memory.

prefer-set-size.reason: Read collection size directly instead of allocating an intermediate array.

prefer-single-call.reason: Separate calls can communicate command or cleanup ordering.

prefer-spread.reason: Avoid imposing extra copies solely to replace equivalent iterator/array helpers.

prefer-string-raw.reason: Raw template syntax is a readability preference for the specific string.

prefer-string-replace-all.reason: Regex replacement may intentionally document flags and pattern semantics.

prefer-string-slice.reason: Existing explicit substring bounds are harmless and well tested.

prefer-string-starts-ends-with.reason: Regexes can intentionally retain anchors/flags; a blanket replacement is not needed.

prefer-string-trim-start-end.reason: Prefer current trim APIs over legacy left/right aliases.

prefer-structured-clone.reason: JSON serialization is intentional at database and transport boundaries.

prefer-ternary.reason: Explicit branches align with feature-model readability and effects separation.

prefer-top-level-await.reason: Tooling and shutdown adapters may intentionally expose asynchronous functions.

prefer-type-error.reason: Existing app error classes carry HTTP status and expected user-facing errors.

relative-url-style.reason: Relative URL spelling is cosmetic; trusted origin validation is enforced separately.

require-array-join-separator.reason: Default comma joins may be intentional; no uniform separator policy is needed.

require-module-attributes.reason: Tooling already pins ESM/JSON behavior; no additional import attribute policy is needed.

require-module-specifiers.reason: Empty export markers intentionally make declaration files modules; TypeScript validates real dependencies.

require-number-to-fixed-digits-argument.reason: The default zero digits may be intentional and is not a safety problem.

require-post-message-target-origin.reason: Require an explicit target origin when communicating across window boundaries.

switch-case-braces.reason: Existing explicit case blocks already follow variable-lifetime needs; no universal brace style.

switch-case-break-position.reason: Switch layout is formatting preference; exhaustive variants are checked separately.

text-encoding-identifier-case.reason: Encoding aliases are equivalent; normalizing spelling has no resource benefit.

throw-new-error.reason: Keep exception construction explicit and reject accidental non-constructed Error calls.
